product.title: Kuromon Market Food Walking Tour in Osaka

description.text: In Osaka, this guided food walk starts at Kuromon Market, continues through Doguyasuji kitchenware street, and finishes in Dotonbori. Published market tastings are listed. The format suits visitors who want a compact market-and-canal window without a six-hour private circuit. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Osaka, and the itinerary stays on Kuromon Market, Doguyasuji, and Dotonbori that define this outing rather than a Namba night walk.

start.description: Meet at the published Kuromon Market meeting point confirmed at booking.

end.description: Return to your Osaka meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
